description: Provider detection logic diverges between proxy/addon.py and providers/registry.py, extending providers edits closed Literal types and hardcoded KNOWN_PROVIDERS tuples, and sibling/package circular imports connect providers sibling modules and parsers <-> providers.
goal: Extract shared message/turn helpers into a leaf module src/holon_coherence/providers/_common.py (removing sibling imports of anthropic.py from openai.py and gemini.py). Add a structural matches(url, payload) seam on ProviderFormat in src/holon_coherence/providers/base.py using structural Protocol typing without closed Literal restrictions, implement matches() across providers, unify proxy/addon.py detect_provider and proxy/routing.py lookup through src/holon_coherence/providers/registry.py, derive KNOWN_PROVIDERS dynamically from the registry in src/holon_coherence/parsers/sse.py, and break circular deferred imports between src/holon_coherence/parsers/{sse,tokens}.py and providers/. Add unit tests in tests/providers/test_provider_format_seam.py verifying single-path provider detection, custom provider registration without editing closed Literals or if/elif chains, and acyclic imports between parsers and providers. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified or added Python files, stay strictly within each module line budget, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Centralizing provider format detection behind a Protocol seam eliminates drift across proxy/parsers/providers and removes circular imports.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one provider-detection code path exists across proxy/addon.py, proxy/routing.py, and providers/registry.py.

Registering a new provider via register_provider() works via ProviderFormat.matches() in providers/base.py across providers/anthropic.py, providers/openai.py, and providers/gemini.py with no core Literal or string if/elif edits.

Zero circular imports remain between parsers/ (parsers/sse.py, parsers/tokens.py) and providers/ and sibling provider modules use providers/_common.py; tests/providers/test_provider_format_seam.py passes with 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes with zero docstrings or comments and untouched module_budgets.json.
